messages.content:
Risk: System Prompt Leakage
Description: The system prompt leakage vulnerability in LLMs refers to the risk that the system prompts or instructions used to steer the behavior of the model can also contain sensitive information that was not intended to be discovered. System prompts are designed to guide the model’s output based on the requirements of the application, but may inadvertently contain secrets. When discovered, this information can be used to facilitate other attacks.
Concern: None
Policy: Operational Security & Critical Infrastructure

Candidate ontology classes:
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentifier: security identifier — any publicly available identifier that is used to identify a security [found by 6/6 queries]
  Siblings: unique product identifier, unique swap identifier, universal loan identifier
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/SoftwareAgent: software agent — digital entity that perceives its environment and takes actions that maximize its chance of successfully achieving its goals [found by 6/6 queries]
  Siblings: automated underwriting system, automated system, party
- https://www.omg.org/spec/Commons/PartiesAndSituations/Agent: agent — something autonomous that can adapt to and interact with its environment [found by 5/6 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#ContentSafetyHazard: Content Safety Hazard — Root class for content safety harm categories relevant to adversarial prompt generation against LLM deployments. [found by 4/6 queries]
- http://taxonomy-refiner.io/ontologies/cso#DangerousInformation: Dangerous Information — Knowledge or instructions that enable serious physical harm, weapons production, or dangerous activities when acquired or executed by untrained individuals outside regulated contexts. [found by 4/6 queries]
  Siblings: Sexual Content, Intellectual Property, Hate and Discrimination
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/SEC/Securities/SecuritiesIdentification/SecurityIdentificationScheme: security identification scheme — formal definition of the structure and application of a particular set of securities identifiers [from restriction: isDefinedIn on SecurityIdentifier]
- https://spec.edmcouncil.org/fibo/ontology/FBC/FinancialInstruments/FinancialInstruments/Security: security — financial instrument that can be bought or sold [from restriction: identifies on SecurityIdentifier]
  Siblings: spot contract, debt instrument, over-the-counter instrument

axes.rationale: System prompt leakage can lead to the exposure of sensitive information, which can be categorized as a content safety hazard.
The risk involves the system prompt, which is part of the software agent (the LLM) and can leak information.
